column1: # List prices, USD per million tokens. One row: model, token kind, rate. A kind is input, output, cache_read, cache_write_5m, cache_write_1h.
# Anthropic: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (read 2026-11-14; standard speed, global routing, no batch discount).
#   The 5m and 1h columns are the cache-write columns of that page. A model id with the suffix +long is the rate of a request whose prompt
#   (input + cache read + cache write) is over the threshold row; the page prices only claude-haiku-5-5 that way.
# OpenAI: https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing (read 2026-11-14; Standard column). A Codex cache write is read as the 30m write column,
#   stored here as cache_write_5m; cache_write_1h is the 12h write column. Codex cached input is cache_read.
